Bold wallpaper, a soft couch, and a coffee table that has heard too many arguments. This is where the future family was supposed to live.
Psychology, romance, and a few books nobody admits to reading. Every shelf here holds someone’s secret.
The desk lamp is still on, the wine glass is empty, and the cursor keeps blinking. Some decisions can’t wait until morning.
